faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Tambaram?
faq.a: Rates range from ₹6,500–₹9,000/sq.ft.; a 1,200 sq.ft. plot costs approximately ₹78 lakhs–₹1.08 crore. Annual appreciation runs 15–20%.

faq.q: Is investing in plots in Tambaram a good long-term decision?
faq.a: Yes — 18–25% yearly appreciation outpaces Chennai averages, driven by metro expansions, airport proximity, and IT corridor growth. Rental yields reach 4–6%.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying a plot in Tambaram?
faq.a: Tamil Nadu charges 7% stamp duty plus 4% registration fee (women buyers get a 1% rebate). Budget an extra 11–12% on the total cost.

faq.q: Can I get a home loan for buying a plot in Tambaram?
faq.a: Yes — banks offer up to 80% financing at 8.5–9.5% interest; CMDA approval makes qualification easier.

faq.q: What is the plot appreciation rate in Tambaram?
faq.a: Plots in Tambaram have doubled in value over five years, with the land rate rising from around ₹5,000 to ₹8,500/sq.ft.

faq.q: Are plots in Tambaram CMDA or DTCP approved?
faq.a: OmShakthy's plots in Tambaram are fully CMDA approved, ensuring legal compliance and eligibility for bank loans.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Tambaram?
faq.a: Verify the Encumbrance Certificate (30+ years), CMDA approval, patta, survey details, NOCs, and planning permission.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Tambaram?
faq.a: Yes — via RBI guidelines using NRE/FCNR accounts, with loans available up to 60% LTV.

faq.q: How to avoid title disputes when buying a plot in Tambaram?
faq.a: Obtain a 30-year EC, verify the ownership chain, engage a lawyer, and mutate the patta immediately after purchase.

faq.q: What are the popular localities to buy plots near Tambaram?
faq.a: Tambaram East/West, Selaiyur, Chrompet, Hasthinapuram, Medavakkam, and Perungalathur all offer strong value.

faq.q: What sizes of plots are available in Tambaram?
faq.a: Sizes range from 600 sq.ft. (starter plots) to 2,400 sq.ft. (premium); 1,200 sq.ft. (20x60 ft) and 1,800 sq.ft. (30x60 ft) are the most popular.

faq.q: Are there gated community plots available in Tambaram?
faq.a: Yes — with 24/7 security, parks, and clubhouses, all CMDA approved with wide internal roads.
